_comment: Copy this file to secrets.json in the same folder. secrets.json is gitignored. Replace each <PLACEHOLDER> with your own value. A value that still contains <...> is ignored, so the untouched example keeps the game offline. Environment variables with the same names override the file. Do not commit secrets.json.
_where: NIHONGOLIFE_SUPABASE_URL is the project URL (https://<SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF>.supabase.co). NIHONGOLIFE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is the public anon key from the Supabase dashboard, not the service_role key. AGORA_APP_ID is the Agora project App ID, not the primary certificate. NIHONGOLIFE_GEMINI_API_KEY is the Gemini API key.
_aliases: Optional older names, used only when the matching field above is empty: supabaseProjectUrl, supabaseAnonKey, agoraAppId, geminiApiKey.
